text.tspan: EC2 host g6.4xlarge · TZ3 · SG with no inbound rules (documented, no IaC)
Host network · ROS 2 domain 42, loopback · TZ4
DDS bus /demo_spot · loopback · no auth or encryption
HTTP + WS · Host and Origin allowlist, no auth
Spot confined-space demo · data flows, trust boundaries and threat status, after the hardening pass (baseline 63c05ef)
Threat register, after the hardening pass
DCV: root-equivalent desktop behind one shared password
HUD: no auth, Host allowlist or connection caps
HUD trusts any publisher's event source, gas flags, frames
Sim framing, presenter tools, overrides not tied to the sim
Narration unchecked: denylist filter only, escapes pass
Bedrock model choice unvalidated, untested, data use undisclosed
SafetyGuard dies with the agent process (Ctrl-C, rm -f)
Retreat fragile: one failed leg or a pose gap abandons it
Any DDS participant can drive, claim, power, un-e-stop
Spoofed payload/gas or probe_result hides a gas hazard
Spoofed odometry or site redirects routes, disarms the guard
World controls (inject, clear, vent, battery) accept anyone
Unencrypted DDS broadcasts transcript, permit, camera, pose
No DDS isolation: domain 0, subnet discovery, no SROS2
Every host-network container can take the role credentials
No IaC; the role can read an NGC key nothing needs
Containers are the only boundary: X11, root, rw mounts
Every operator can become root; DCV and Run Command not session-logged
Images, packages, assets by mutable tag; no digest or hash
Known-vulnerable components; no scan or patch cadence
Public PRs pass no CI, scanners or CODEOWNERS
Internal AWS identifiers in docs, defaults and history
fetch-log writes to an un-ignored logs/; captures unredacted
Attendant names spread everywhere; no minimisation, retention
Audit trail: editable on the host; anchored in the session log
Hand-built GPU host; optional budget and idle stop; no g6 recovery
DDS flood slows the sim, evicts alarms, starves telemetry
Low, not badged: T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T12, T35 and T40 (fixed); T13, T14, T15, T18, T19, T30, T41 and T43 (partially fixed). The register gives each one's rating.
Not drawn: F1 EC2 start/stop, F8 DCV console session, F22 sim log, F27 tools/ screenshots, F31 laptop dry run (inset), F34 real gas detector,
F35 account cleanup automation stop, F36 GDM and desktop settings, F37 account logs, F38 SSM command history, F39-F41 session logs, their export, the idle-stop check;
nor the spot-rec and e2e containers (C39), the idle-stop timer (C40) or the optional guardrail and session-log stacks (C41, D13).
Red edges carry untrusted or unauthenticated input; purple carry credentials; grey are in-process or future. The bus stops at the host's loopback (TB5) but has no boundary between participants.
unit tests with fakes; HUD --fake or --replay on 127.0.0.1; agent --dry-run, which still calls Bedrock (F31)
with the laptop's default AWS credential chain. The same prompt content, operator text and tool results leave the laptop as leave the host (T11, T37).
